description: Cloudflare Cache Rules Configuration for NISER Digital Platform
notes: Rules are evaluated in ORDER — first match wins. Place bypass rules BEFORE cache-everything rules.
Cloudflare Cache Rules run at REQUEST phase; do NOT use http.response.status in expressions here.
Edge TTL (s-maxage) is how long Cloudflare's edge holds the response.
Browser TTL (max-age) is how long the user's browser caches the response.
Cache-Tag purging requires Cloudflare Enterprise or Cache Reserve. Tags are set in middleware.ts.
All API write endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE) are force-bypassed via the no-cache rule.

rules.description: BYPASS: Never cache write endpoints, AI generation, webhooks, or auth-gated APIs

criteria.expression: (http.request.method ne "GET") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/admin/")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/chatbot")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/subscribe")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/embed")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/fcm")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/revalidate")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/policy-brief")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/policy-monitor")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/literature-assistant")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/translate")) or (has_header("Authorization")) or (has_header("x-internal-ai-secret"))

rules.description: Cache immutable static assets for 1 year (Next.js _next/static, fonts, images in /public)

criteria.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/image")) or (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff2") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ttf") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".eot") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ico") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webmanifest"))

rules.description: Cache public images (WebP, PNG, JPG, SVG, GIF) for 30 days

criteria.expression: (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".png") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpeg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".gif") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".avif")) and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/"))

rules.description: Cache public GET /api/search for 2 minutes (short TTL for freshness)
Cache public GET /api/data (Open Data Catalogue) for 10 minutes
Cache GET /api/recommendations for 5 minutes (NOTE: route currently POST-only — update route to support GET for caching)
Cache GET /api/ai/status for 30 seconds (health check, short TTL)
Cache dynamic content pages (publications, insights, events, people, news, policy-briefs) for 6 hours at edge

criteria.expression: (http.request.method eq "GET") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/publications") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/insights") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/events") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/people") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/news") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/policy-briefs") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/research") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/research-centers") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/working-groups"))

rules.description: Cache semi-static pages (about, contact, governance, careers, etc.) for 24 hours at edge

criteria.expression: (http.request.method eq "GET") and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/about") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/contact") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/governance") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/careers") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/internships") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/partnerships") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/services") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/training") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/funding-opportunities") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bckc-center") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/resources") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/webinars") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/gallery") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/privacy-policy"))

rules.description: Cache archive/report pages for 7 days — these change rarely
BYPASS: Never cache the admin dashboard UI
BYPASS: Never cache AI chatbot, search UI, cart, shop (personalised/interactive pages)

criteria.expression: starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/chatbot") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/search") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/shop") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/subscribe") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/translate") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/literature-assistant") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ai-policy-brief")

rate_limiting.description: Limit general API requests to 120 per minute per IP (generous for public research site)
Limit search API to 60 per minute per IP
Limit AI chatbot to 10 per minute per IP (expensive generative endpoint)
Limit AI generation endpoints (policy-brief, literature-assistant, translate) to 5 per minute per IP
Limit newsletter subscribe to 3 per minute per IP (anti-spam)

waf_rules.description: Challenge high-threat-score bots and unverified scrapers on API write endpoints
Block basic SQL injection patterns in query strings
waf_rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "union select") or (http.request.uri.query contains "drop table") or (http.request.uri.query contains "insert into") or (http.request.uri.query contains "' or '1'='1")

waf_rules.description: Challenge access to /admin from outside Nigeria (adjust countries as needed)
waf_rules.note: Remove or adjust this rule if administrators work internationally

waf_rules.description: Block /api/revalidate calls missing the token query param entirely (extra hardening)
Block /api/fcm from external non-verified sources (should only be triggered server-side)

cache_tags.description: Cache tags are set in middleware.ts as 'Cache-Tag' response headers. Use Cloudflare API to purge by tag when ISR revalidation runs.

cache_control_headers.description: These Cache-Control values are set by middleware.ts (see file). Cloudflare respects s-maxage for edge TTL.

cloudflare_settings.note_rocket_loader: Disabled — Next.js bundles its own script loading. Rocket Loader can break RSC hydration.

setup_steps: 1. Log in to the Cloudflare dashboard → select niser.gov.ng
2. Caching → Cache Rules → Create rules 1-12 in order (priority 1 = first evaluated)
3. Security → Rate Limiting → Create the 5 rate limiting rules above
4. Security → WAF → Custom Rules → Create WAF rules 1-5 above
5. Speed → Optimization → enable Brotli, Polish (Lossless), WebP, Early Hints
6. SSL/TLS → set mode to Full (strict) and enable Always Use HTTPS
7. Add CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to .env.production and Dockerfile/CI secrets
9. In WordPress CMS webhook settings, point to: POST https://niser.gov.ng/api/revalidate?token=<ISR_REVALIDATE_TOKEN>&type=publication&id={id}
10. Monitor: Analytics → Cache → target Cache Hit Ratio > 80%

env_vars_required.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: Cloudflare API token with Zone:Cache Purge permission — add to .env.production
env_vars_required.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: Zone ID from Cloudflare dashboard (Overview page, right sidebar) — add to .env.production
env_vars_required.ISR_REVALIDATE_TOKEN: Random secret for the /api/revalidate webhook — generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

key_metrics: Origin response time (should drop significantly after cache warm-up)
